entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsAircraftProductionEdict
entry.value: Naval Orders

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsAircraftProductionEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the production output of Voidports in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsAircraftProductionEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Council Munitorum: to all voidport overseers. Laborer sleep cycles have been shortened, and production quotas have been increased—every hour counts, and our brothers and sisters need air cover. Arbiters have been dispatched to ensure compliance with this edict.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsDefenseEdict
entry.value: Bulwark of the New Mankind

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsDefenseEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the armour of allied units in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsDefenseEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Council Militarum: to all General Staff, Regimental Commanders, Company Commanders. All units are to be kept under or behind protective cover at all times, even during R&R. Every life saved is someone who will see the dawn of the new state. Additional resources for repairs have been allocated. Hold your ground until the end!

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsEnergyEdict
entry.value: Running Hot

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsEnergyEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the energy output of Plasma Ionisers in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsEnergyEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Council Munitorum: to all power unit overseers. Safeguards are to be removed on all plasma ionisers - the risk is justified; Workers lost in accidents will be honored as fallen heroes of the New Humanity—their names will be inscribed on the memorial walls.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsFoodEdict
entry.value: Provisioning mobilization

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsFoodEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the food output of Soylens Farms in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsFoodEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Council Munitorum: To all citizens of New Humanity. Personal rations have been temporarily reduced—every extra ration is being sent to the frontline. Arbiters have been dispatched to farms and warehouses to oversee inventory and ensure fair distribution. We will share the hunger so that our soldiers do not have to share death.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsGrowthEdict
entry.value: Decree on Population

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsGrowthEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the growth rate of the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsGrowthEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Munitorum Council: To all registered building custodians. To make up for losses and strengthen the power of the New Humanity, a family support program is being introduced. Marital relations are encouraged; contraceptives are temporarily excluded from supplies. Additionally, a program to recruit defectors from the Imperium has been launched—we will provide shelter to anyone seeking a better life.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsInfantryProductionEdict
entry.value: Accelerated mobilization

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsInfantryProductionEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the production output of Imperial Barracks in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsInfantryProductionEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Militum Council: To all Commissars and recruitment officers. Volunteer recruitment has been expanded. By order, the recruitment of prisoners and captives who have expressed a desire to atone for their sins before the New Humanity is hereby authorized. Casualties among the recruits are to be expected, but every survivor will be granted freedom and citizenship.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsInfluenceEdict
entry.value: Voice of the New Humanity

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsInfluenceEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the influence output of Cogitator Stations in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsInfluenceEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Broadcasting Division: To operators of cogitator stations. You are ordered to intensify broadcasts: the programming must include reports from the front lines, the names of heroes, the exposure of the Imperium’s lies, and an explanation of the advantages of the New Humanity. The recruitment of volunteers to conduct propaganda among civilians is encouraged. Every voice heard is another potential ally or defector.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsLoyaltyEdict
entry.value: Strengthening legal system

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsLoyaltyEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the loyalty output of Sancti Imperialum in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsLoyaltyEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Adeptus Arbitres: To all Commissars, judges, and law enforcement officers: A period of law enforcement based on the Lex Novae Humanitatis is hereby initiated; adherence to our regulations is the key to survival. Treason, looting, and panic are crimes against our comrades. Justice must be swift, but impartial!

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsOreEdict
entry.value: Labor mobilization

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsOreEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the ore output of Ore Extractors in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsOreEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Munitorum Council: To all factory masters. For the duration of this edict, the entire able-bodied civilian population is considered mobilized for resource extraction. The workday has been extended, and rest periods reduced. Losses among workers will be compensated for by conscripts and disloyal prisoners. You are our mainstay, and we ask that you exert every ounce of your strength. The survival of the New Humanity depends on each and every one of you.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsResearchEdict
entry.value: Revelations of the Omnissiah

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsResearchEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the research output of Officiis Tacticas in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsResearchEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Adeptus Xenariatus: to all Tech-Priests. During this cycle, the Quest for Knowledge takes precedence. Research into xenos designs and exploratory missions are to be encouraged. Praise the Omnissiah!

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsVehicleProductionEdict
entry.value: Rites of the Machine Spirits

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsVehicleProductionEdictDescription
entry.value: Edict that increases the production output of Manufactorums in the city.

entry.name: SeparatistRegimentsVehicleProductionEdictFlavor
entry.value: Edict, Adeptus Mechanicus: to all Manufactorum Magi. Production quotas for this period are raised. Personal projects must be put on hold during this time. Additional resources / unguents will be provided for performance of the machine rites. Praise the Omnissiah!

entry.name: AuraOfDiscipline
entry.value: Aura of Discipline

entry.name: AuraOfDisciplineDescription
entry.value: Increases the accuracy of the Commissar and adjacent allied Separatist Regiments infantry.

entry.name: AuraOfDisciplineFlavor
entry.value: Should discipline or morale falter, it is the task of the Commissar to take whatever steps necessary to restore order, and to do so in the absolute knowledge that his actions are just. Under the steely gaze of such a man, Guardsmen must be inspired to deeds they never believed possible.

entry.value: Deploy %1%

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/DeployDroneDescription
entry.value: Deploys temporary %1%.

entry.name: MarkerlightDescription
entry.value: Increases the ranged accuracy of Separatist Regiments against the target enemy non-fortification unit. Reduces the ranged damage reduction of the target enemy non-fortification unit against Separatist Regiments. Ends after the target enemy unit is attacked by Separatist Regiments.

entry.name: MarkerlightFlavor
entry.value: A markerlight is a hand - held device that projects a simple beam onto a target which then transmits a torrent of targeting data to other Separatist Regiments units, allowing them to engage the target with unerring accuracy.
